Connecting your world. Offen für Mehr mit Magenta. 1 TV & Streaming Platform Engineer (f/m/d)

 Vienna  asap  fulltime  Unlimited

We are Magenta

Magenta Telekom is a leading provider of internet, mobile communications, entertainment and business solutions in Austria. The company counts around 2,200 employees and is part of the Deutsche Telekom Group.

Shape the Future of MagentaTV with Us!

Millions of TV streams, live events, on-demand content, and a platform that must be available 24/7 - that's our daily business.

As part of the MagentaTV Engineering Team, we are responsible for the entire technical platform end-to-end: from content acquisition and signal processing to content distribution and client delivery. Together, we ensure that our customers enjoy a first-class entertainment experience anytime, anywhere.

To achieve this, we are looking for people who love technical challenges, take ownership, and want to actively shape the future of MagentaTV.

 * Own and continuously evolve our TV and streaming platform, ensuring reliability, scalability, and outstanding performance

 * Improve products, systems, and processes while driving the adoption and integration of innovative technologies

 * Partner with Product and Content teams to turn business requirements into robust technical solutions

 * Lead technical collaboration with broadcasters, studios, content providers, and technology partners across the platform ecosystem

 * Solve complex technical challenges, champion innovation, and actively shape the future of the platform through new ideas and initiatives

 * Do you have a degree in Media Engineering, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field, or several years of hands-on experience working with TV, IPTV, or streaming platforms?

 * Are you experienced with DVB-C, IPTV, OTT, and modern streaming technologies, including protocols (e.g. HLS, MPEG-DASH, MPEG-TS, RTP, RTSP, and Multicast)?

 * Do you have practical knowledge of video delivery workflows and platform components such as encoding, transcoding, multiplexing, packaging, CDN, nPVR, Catch-up TV, and DRM solutions?

 * Are you comfortable working in Linux-based environments and do you bring solid networking expertise, ideally including Cisco technologies and multicast architectures?

 * Do you combine a structured, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to navigate complex technical environments, while staying up to date with trends and innovations in TV, media, and streaming technologies?

 * Are you experienced working in agile teams using tools such as Jira and Confluence, possess excellent English communication skills, and are willing to participate in an on-call rotation?

At Magenta, we believe in diverse employees and live equal opportunities. We welcome all applications regardless of cultural and social background, age, gender, nationality, religion, disability or sexual orientation. Magenta connects all people.

 * Food voucher

 * Flexible working hours

 * Health care

 * Job ticket

 * Learning offers

 * Homeoffice

 * Benefits

 * Company pension plan

We are Magenta, you too?

According to the collective agreement for the telecommunications industry, this position carries a minimum gross monthly salary of € 3.413,78 based on full-time employment (38.5 hours per week). We will discuss your actual salary with you in person, taking into account your individual qualifications and professional experience. You can expect an attractive offer that exceeds the minimum stipulated by the agreement.

You want to find out more about us? Get a glimpse of our Magenta World - https://www.magenta.at

1 Master Thesis - Brillouin-Active Integrated Photonics (all genders) // Job-ID: 244-0 
Praktikum/Werkstudium, Vollzeit · VILLACH

Your future responsibilities
We are seeking a motivated Master Student to carry out a Master Thesis in the field of nonlinear integrated photonics, in collaboration with an established industrial and research partner. This thesis focuses on advanced optical modulation techniques and experimental characterization of photonic systems. You will work on the implementation and analysis of coherent modulation schemes, including IQ modulation for carrier-suppressed single-sideband (CS-SSB) operation and dual-sideband modulation. The work combines numerical modeling, hands-on experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations using heterodyne measurement techniques. If you are eager to deepen your expertise in integrated photonics, optical modulation, and experimental photonics, this thesis offers an excellent opportunity to develop strong technical and research skills. 
Your Tasks Will Include:

 * Development and analysis of integrated photonic modulation schemes:
 ** Conducting a focused literature review on coherent optical modulation and photonic integrated circuits.
 ** Implementing and analyzing IQ modulation schemes for CS-SSB generation.
 ** Investigating and comparing dual-sideband modulation techniques.
 * Experimental characterization of photonic and acousto-optic components:
 ** Characterizing the performance of an acousto-optic modulator (AOM).
 ** Setting up and performing heterodyne measurement experiments.
 ** Analyzing measured data and extracting key performance metrics.
 * Numerical modeling and data analysis using dedicated simulation and scripting tools (e.g., Matlab, Python, Comsol).
 * Documenting results and presenting outcomes in the form of a Master's thesis and internal presentations.

Your profile
 * Bachelor's degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Photonics, or a related field, and currently enrolled in a Master's program (EU university), with good academic performance.
 * Preferred skills:
 ** Basic knowledge of integrated photonics and optical modulation formats.
 ** Familiarity with coherent optical systems and RF-optical signal processing.
 ** Hands-on experience with optical laboratory equipment and measurement techniques (heterodyne measurements are an advantage).
 * Experience with Matlab, Python, Comsol, or similar numerical and data-analysis tools.
 * Motivated, detail-oriented, and eager to learn, with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a research team.
 * Good written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly document and present technical results using standard Microsoft Office tools.

Important Facts about SAL
 * Duration: 6 months
 * Diversified research activities with plenty of technical challenges. 
 * State-of-the-art lab facilities and instruments. 
 * Internal and external training opportunities for further development.
 * € 4 per day food allowance in restaurants or € 2 per day in supermarkets. 
 * Family & kids friendly. 
 * Free coffee/milk/tea & fresh fruits. 
 * Our values: 
 ** Open door policy, flexibility in working hours, casual dress code, diverse teams, working with people of different nationalities, informal communication, lifelong learning,compatibility of family and career, sustainability, personal growth, and collective advancement. 

This position is subject to the Collective Agreement for employees in non-university research (Research CA). For this position, we offer a monthly gross salary of EUR 1.929, paid 14 times a year.
